items.title: Resolve security signals faster with Arctic Wolf’s Aurora Agentic SOC
items.summary: In this post, you’ll learn how Arctic Wolf ingests security telemetry using an event-driven architecture built on AWS. You can get started with Arctic Wolf in AWS Marketplace.
items.creator: Tim Sitze

items.title: Shorten the time from credential exposure to remediation with SpyCloud
items.summary: In this post, you’ll learn how SpyCloud built and operates its data pipeline using Amazon Web Services (AWS) offerings and how you can use it to protect your organization.
items.creator: Tim Sitze
